title: Tenant Wars
overview:
Lots of real-life stores appear. Aim to become the top tenant owner!

A board game about running shops in a shopping mall. Roll your way around the board, open stores on the squares you land on, and cash in when rivals stop at your shops and have to buy something. Whoever has the most money at the end wins.

- Many real Japanese chains appear as shops, including TSUTAYA, Denny's, Autobacs, H.I.S., Lotteria and Matsumoto Kiyoshi
- Choose from a cast of cute characters
- Up to six players at once with the Multi Terminal 6, or play solo

実際にあるお店もたくさん登場
目指せトップテナントオーナー！
